translations.web: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
translations.bsb: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
translations.kjv: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
translations.asv: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
